appDesc.message: Apply FIRST TLP 2.0 markings to outgoing email in Roundcube Webmail. No tracking, no external servers.

selectorClearTitle.message: Remove the TLP classification from this message

warningConflicts.message: Conflicting classifications found ({levels}). Choose one explicitly.

warningLegacyWhite.message: This conversation uses the obsolete TLP:WHITE. It should be TLP:CLEAR.

warningOriginalNotAllowed.message: The original message is classified {level}, which is not permitted by policy. Choose an allowed classification.

warningDowngrade.message: Lowering from {from} to {to}. Wider sharing needs the source's permission.

blockMessage.message: Choose a classification so the subject and body clearly show the sharing boundary.

confirmDowngradeSubtitle.message: This widens who may receive the information.

issue_LEVEL_NOT_ALLOWED.message: {level} is no longer approved. Choose an approved classification before sending.

issue_NO_CLASSIFICATION.message: This message has no TLP classification.

issue_SUBJECT_NOT_MARKED.message: The subject is not marked with {level}.

issue_SUBJECT_MISMATCH.message: The subject is marked {actual} but {level} was selected.

issue_SUBJECT_CONFLICT.message: The subject contains conflicting TLP classifications.

issue_SUBJECT_DUPLICATE.message: The subject contains more than one {level} marking.

issue_BODY_NOT_MARKED.message: The message body has no {level} marking.

issue_BODY_MISMATCH.message: The message body leads with {actual} but {level} was selected.

issue_BODY_AMBIGUOUS.message: The message body contains conflicting TLP classifications without a clear leading mark.

issue_DOWNGRADE.message: You are lowering the classification from {from} to {to}. TLP does not permit wider sharing without the source's explicit permission. Only continue if you are authorised to do so.

issue_QUOTED_HIGHER.message: The quoted text contains {quoted}, which is more restrictive than the selected {level}. Quoting it here may share that information more widely than its source allows.

issue_LEGACY_WHITE.message: This conversation contains the obsolete TLP:WHITE designation. It should be TLP:CLEAR.

tlpClearSummary.message: Can be shared with the world; no disclosure limit.

tlpGreenSummary.message: Share within the community, not via public channels.

tlpAmberSummary.message: Share on a need-to-know basis within the organisation and its clients.

tlpAmberStrictSummary.message: Share only within the organisation (no clients).

tlpRedSummary.message: For the individual recipient only; no further disclosure.

tlpClearDesc.message: TLP:CLEAR — Recipients may share this information with anyone, publicly or otherwise. Subject to standard copyright rules.

tlpGreenDesc.message: TLP:GREEN — Recipients may share this with peers and partner organisations within their community, but not via publicly accessible channels.

tlpAmberDesc.message: TLP:AMBER — Recipients may share this on a need-to-know basis within their own organisation and its clients.

tlpAmberStrictDesc.message: TLP:AMBER+STRICT — Recipients may share this only with members of their own organisation on a need-to-know basis. Clients are excluded unless the source permits it.

tlpRedDesc.message: TLP:RED — For the eyes and ears of individual recipients only. Recipients may not share this information with anyone else.

optGeneralHint.message: The extension only runs on the webmail domains you authorise below. It never sends data anywhere.

optDomainsHint.message: Add the exact hostname of your Roundcube instance (for example mail.example.gov). Access is requested per domain. Nothing is enabled until you approve the browser prompt.

optMissingBlock.message: Block sending until one is selected

optWarnDowngrade.message: Warn when a reply or forward lowers the classification

optBehaviourHint.message: TLP does not permit wider sharing without the source's explicit permission. Downgrades are warned about, never performed silently.

optMarkSubject.message: Add the TLP label to the subject line (e.g. [TLP:AMBER] …)

optMarkBody.message: Add the TLP label at the top of the message body

optColorCoding.message: Use official TLP colour coding (the text label is always shown)

optPrivacy1.message: No telemetry, analytics, tracking, or external APIs.

optPrivacy2.message: No email content, recipients, or attachments are read for anything but on-screen marking, and none are stored.

optPrivacy3.message: Settings are stored only in this browser profile (storage.local).

optPrivacy4.message: No remote code and no dynamic evaluation.

optPrivacyHint.message: Browser-side checks are advisory: they can be bypassed and are not a substitute for server-side policy or data-loss prevention.

optManagedBannerText.message: Locked settings and hosts are configured by policy and cannot be changed here.

optStatusInvalidDomain.message: Enter a valid hostname, for example mail.example.gov

optStatusManaged.message: Your administrator manages the host list.

popupFootnote.message: No tracking. No external servers. Settings stay in this browser profile.

popupNotWebPage.message: This page is not a supported web page.

popupNotAuthorisedManaged.message: Not authorised on {host}. Your administrator manages the host list.
